reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a sort or merge file SELECTed more than once in one program's FILE-CONTROL paragraph, an SD whose file no SELECT of the same program names, a SELECT with no SD (or FD) in the same program's Data Division (including the split where the SELECT is in a containing program and the SD in a contained one), and a second SD of the same file; one SELECT plus one SD compiles and sorts.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 a sort-merge entry is screened by §1985:XI.2.3.3 SR2 (ASSIGN only) instead of the 2023 sort-merge rows; it is the sibling rule, not SR1's once-only / has-an-SD checks

reader.edition-search: grep of DialectLevel/Edition.Edition/CobolVersion over FileControlBinder.cs, FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs and FileControlKeyRules.cs: the hits are PADDING (2014), RECORD CONTAINS (2002) and FileControlKeyRules.RulesFor/sortMerge1985 (SR2's rows); the SR1 checks themselves (SelectedFiles.ContainsKey -> COBOL2634, the SD arm's FilesByName miss -> COBOL2636, ScreenSelectsHaveDescriptions -> COBOL2635, DescriptionRepeated -> COBOL4250) read no edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover an SD with no SELECT, per-program SELECT scope with a legal sort file, and legal 1985 entries; not exercised: a sort file SELECTed twice, a SELECT with no SD at all, the containing/contained split of SELECT and SD, and a doubled SD

probes.expected: refused: sort file specified twice in FILE-CONTROL

reader.notes: Both sentences are answered by the general SELECT/FD/SD pairing screens, which are edition-blind and per program unit; each violation form is refused at --std 85. Messages cite §2023 clauses at --std 85. r4e was a malformed probe (paragraph outside sections) and was replaced by r4g.
